pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"Someone home: the code at the door, entered by the crew lead. Nobody home (most plan visits): no code; the lead opens the lockbox or door code.","entry_codes":"Shown only to the crew lead, only on the visit day, and each opening is logged. The key goes back in the lockbox at the end.","lockout":"No way in when nobody needs to be home (a lockbox, door or garage code fails): the crew lead texts it, Alex gets a link for a new code, and the crew waits 30 minutes, then leaves. A lockout fee only if the owner confirms it.","drop_off":"At the business: the code is given at the counter when the rug or curtains are left. Status words IN, DRYING, READY. READY comes with a photo. Pick-up only by the customer or someone they name.","changes_at_visit":"Add-ons only when the customer asks, priced before they're done. DONE with after photos when nobody's home.","breakage":"Reported with photos the same day; the owner decides how to make it right."}
pluginText.pf.money: {"start":"House cleaning: a card saved at booking, charged at DONE. Drop-offs: nothing taken, paid at the counter at pick-up.","deposits":"None by default. Deposit cap: from the state form.","fees":"Late cancel and lockout: the business's own fee (the example: $89), never more than the visit's price. The owner confirms each one; no answer, no fee.","plans":"Each plan visit is charged at its own DONE. Rosfield's $2 counts once a month for a plan.","tips":"Optional, all to the crew. A tip line only if the owner turns it on. How card tips are handled follows the state's rules, from the state form.","tax":"A sales tax line only where the state taxes house cleaning, from the state form.","rosfield_fee":"The usual $2 per confirmed booking."}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_texts":["Entry, lockbox, door, garage and alarm codes","Where a key is kept","Health reasons, like an allergy behind a product to avoid"],"photos":"Photos of the home go only to the customer and the business.","languages":"English and Spanish. pluginText.pf.staff: {"skills":["Deep and standard cleans","Move-out cleans","Carpet shampoo","Window washing","Rug washing, stain removal, antique rugs"],"crews":"Two per home clean: a lead, who holds the entry code and texts DONE, and a helper.","licenses":"None per person unless the state's form says so.","new_person_ok":"A cleaner the customer hasn't booked is offered by text first, never sent without an OK. pluginText.pf.rules: {"plans":["The plan's terms show before any card is asked: how often, the price a visit, when it's charged, that it runs until ended, and how to end it.","The plan gets its own yes, apart from the booking, and the terms are texted back.","One reply ends it.","A price change is told 30 days ahead, or more where the state's rules ask.","Any reminder the state's rules require for a running plan."],"add_on_at_home":"A right to cancel where the state's rules give one for work sold at the home.","written_contract":"Above an amount, where the state's rules require it.","landlord":"A move-out clean booked by a renter may need the landlord's or manager's OK.","records":"7 years, with the before and after photos."}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"matter_most":["Lockout: a code that fails when nobody needs to be home. The crew waits 30 minutes, then leaves; the owner decides any fee.","Something breaks during the clean: photos the same day; the owner decides.","Missed spots: tell the business within 24 hours; a free re-clean of those areas within 48 hours. A redo, never money from Rosie.","A crew member is out: a new person is offered first; no answer, the rest of the crew comes for longer.","Skip, pause or end a plan, and a plan's price change.","Mold or sewage found during the clean: that area stops; a written note goes to the customer.","A rug or curtains not picked up: reminders; after the free days, a storage fee only if the owner starts it, after written notice.","Weather over the limit for outside window washing: Sam keeps the visit or moves it, with no fee.","Several open bookings (a plan's next visits): which one is asked first."],"rest":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way."}
